name: Phantom Pipeline Test Project
description: Sample test project to verify the orchestrator works end-to-end. Demonstrates ops-check integration.
initial_idea: Create a simple echo agent that responds to test commands, runs phantom-ops-check, and logs success.

phases.content:
Build a minimal test agent for demonstrating phantom-pipeline functionality. It should:
1. Trigger phantom-ops-check pre-flight.
2. Log a test message.
3. Complete the full workflow successfully.
phases.author: Human
